mechanism.claim: On Monday-Friday New York mornings, the completed 09:30-10:00 local BTC move captures the first directional risk transfer of the nominal US cash-open overlap; when strictly prior BTC variation is elevated, follow that opening direction from 10:05 through 16:00 local.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed 09:30-10:00 America/New_York BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCOM uses a DST-aware recurring weekday New York clock and a disjoint completed opening half-hour to trade only the remainder of the nominal cash session. The US-cash-close candidate waits for the full session; Thursday macro candidates trade one weekday after 08:30 releases; UTC intraday candidates use different clocks. It uses no equity return, holiday fit, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event, repair, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the twenty-four elapsed hours ending before the opening response must rank in the causal upper 35%, focusing the clock on July-like risk-transfer days
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: DST-aware 10:05 New York weekday entries ending at 16:00 local are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.reaction_window: six exact completed BTCUSDT five-minute bars [09:30,10:00) local, each from five coherent one-minute rows
features.reaction_return: log(09:55 bar close/09:30 bar open), finite strict nonzero
features.variation_window: 288 exact completed five-minute bars over the twenty-four elapsed hours ending at 09:30 local
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared five-minute open-to-close log returns), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier source-valid weekday decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.timezone: America/New_York via IANA, including DST folds/gaps
features.calendar: Monday-Friday local only; no exchange-holiday inference or outcome-dependent exclusion

clock.reservation: nonoverlapping chronological half-open positions; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: predefined weekday New York opening-overlap continuation clock under requested high variation

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no weekday calendar, timezone, reaction window, variation, side, entry, exit, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.origin: predefined US cash-open overlap clock; no empirical BTC coefficient is claimed
external_basis.fixed_definition: every Monday-Friday in America/New_York; reaction [09:30,10:00), entry 10:05, exit 16:00; Python IANA timezone rules; exchange holidays intentionally not inferred or filtered
external_basis.selection_use: institutional overlap clock and continuation direction fixed without opening candidate incidence or outcomes
